about.text: A hard, artisanal, surface-washed alpine cheese from Vorarlberg, made only from raw milk from pastures at 1,000 to 1,800 m, in the grazing season from May to September. Wheels weigh up to 40 kg and are ripened at least three months.

sources.text: The PDO criteria and the Alpkäse article, for its altitude, season, size and ripening.
